pairs: Ut ergo cognovit Jesus quia audierunt pharisæi quod Jesus plures discipulos facit,
when Jesus realized that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus made more disciples
and he traveled again to Galilee.
Oportebat autem eum transire per Samariam.
Now he needed to cross through Samaria.
he went into a city of Samaria which is called Sychar,
juxta prædium quod dedit Jacob Joseph filio suo.
near the estate which Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
And so Jesus, being tired from the journey,
was sitting in a certain way on the well.
It was about the sixth hour.
Venit mulier de Samaria haurire aquam.
A woman of Samaria arrived to draw water.
(Discipuli enim ejus abierant in civitatem ut cibos emerent.)
For his disciples had gone into the city in order to buy food.
Dicit ergo ei mulier illa Samaritana:
And so, that Samaritan woman said to him,
“How is it that you, being a Jew,
are requesting a drink from me,
though I am a Samaritan woman?”
For the Jews do not associate with the Samaritans.
“If you knew the gift of God,
et quis est qui dicit tibi:
and who it is who is saying to you,
perhaps you would have made a request of him,
and he would have given you living water.”
Domine, neque in quo haurias habes,
“Lord, you do not have anything with which to draw water,
From where, then, do you have living water?
Numquid tu major es patre nostro Jacob,
Surely, you are not greater than our father Jacob,
qui dedit nobis puteum, et ipse ex eo bibit,
who gave us the well and who drank from it,
et filii ejus, et pecora ejus?
with his sons and his cattle?”
Jesus responded and said to her:
Omnis qui bibit ex aqua hac, sitiet iterum;
“All who drink from this water will thirst again.
qui autem biberit ex aqua quam ego dabo ei, non sitiet in æternum:
But whoever shall drink from the water that I will give to him will not thirst for eternity.
sed aqua quam ego dabo ei, fiet in eo fons aquæ salientis in vitam æternam.
Instead, the water that I will give to him will become in him a fountain of water, springing up into eternal life.”
so that I may not thirst
and may not come here to draw water.”
For you have had five husbands,
et nunc, quem habes, non est tuus vir:
but he whom you have now is not your husband.
You have spoken this in truth.”
I see that you are a Prophet.
Patres nostri in monte hoc adoraverunt,
Our fathers worshipped on this mountain,
et vos dicitis, quia Jerosolymis est locus ubi adorare oportet.
but you say that Jerusalem is the place where one ought to worship.”
the hour is coming when you shall worship the Father,
You worship what you do not know;
we worship what we do know.
For salvation is from the Jews.
quando veri adoratores adorabunt Patrem in spiritu et veritate.
when true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit
For the Father also seeks such persons who may worship him.
in spiritu et veritate oportet adorare.
those who worship him must worship in spirit and in truth.”
Scio quia Messias venit (qui dicitur Christus):
“I know that the Messiah is coming (who is called the Christ).
And then, when he will have arrived,
he will announce everything to us.”
the one who is speaking with you.”
et mirabantur quia cum muliere loquebatur.
And they wondered that he was speaking with the woman.
And so the woman left behind her water jar
And she said to the men there:
et videte hominem qui dixit mihi omnia quæcumque feci:
and see a man who has told me all the things that I have done.
they went out of the city and came to him.
Ego cibum habeo manducare, quem vos nescitis.
“I have food to eat which you do not know.”
Therefore, the disciples said to one another,
“Could someone have brought him something to eat?”
Meus cibus est ut faciam voluntatem ejus qui misit me,
“My food is to do the will of the One who sent me,
so that I may perfect his work.
Nonne vos dicitis quod adhuc quatuor menses sunt,
Do you not say, ‘There are still four months,
et messis venit? Ecce dico vobis:
and then the harvest arrives?’ Behold,
levate oculos vestros, et videte regiones,
I say to you: Lift up your eyes and look at the countryside;
quia albæ sunt jam ad messem.
for it is already ripe for the harvest.
mercedem accipit, et congregat fructum in vitam æternam:
receives wages and gathers fruit unto eternal life,
ut et qui seminat, simul gaudeat, et qui metit.
so that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.
In hoc enim est verbum verum:
For in this the word is true:
that it is one who sows,
and it is another who reaps.
Ego misi vos metere quod vos non laborastis:
I have sent you to reap that for which you did not labor.
et vos in labores eorum introistis.
and you have entered into their labors.”
Ex civitate autem illa multi crediderunt in eum Samaritanorum,
Now many of the Samaritans from that city believed in him,
because of the word of the woman who was offering testimony:
Quia dixit mihi omnia quæcumque feci.
“For he told me all the things that I have done.”
Cum venissent ergo ad illum Samaritani,
Therefore, when the Samaritans had come to him,
they petitioned him to lodge there.
And he lodged there for two days.
Et multo plures crediderunt in eum propter sermonem ejus.
And many more believed in him, because of his own word.
And they said to the woman:
Quia jam non propter tuam loquelam credimus:
“Now we believe, not because of your speech,
but because we ourselves have heard him,
et scimus quia hic est vere Salvator mundi.
and so we know that he is truly the Savior of the world.”
Post duos autem dies exiit inde,
Then, after two days, he departed from there,
Ipse enim Jesus testimonium perhibuit, quia propheta in sua patria honorem non habet.
For Jesus himself offered testimony that a Prophet has no honor in his own country.
And so, when he had arrived in Galilee,
cum omnia vidissent quæ fecerat Jerosolymis in die festo:
because they had seen all that he had done at Jerusalem, in the day of the feast.
et ipsi enim venerant ad diem festum.
For they also went to the feast day.
Venit ergo iterum in Cana Galilææ,
Then he went again into Cana of Galilee,
where he made water into wine.
And there was a certain ruler,
whose son was sick at Capernaum.
Hic cum audisset quia Jesus adveniret a Judæa in Galilæam,
Since he had heard that Jesus came to Galilee from Judea,
and begged him to come down
For he was beginning to die.
“Unless you have seen signs and wonders,
come down before my son dies.”
Credidit homo sermoni quem dixit ei Jesus,
The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him,
Then, as he was going down,
saying that his son was alive.
Interrogabat ergo horam ab eis in qua melius habuerit.
Therefore, he asked them at which hour he had become better.
Quia heri hora septima reliquit eum febris.
“Yesterday, at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”
Then the father realized that it was at the same hour that Jesus said to him,
quia illa hora erat in qua dixit ei Jesus:
et credidit ipse et domus ejus tota.
Hoc iterum secundum signum fecit Jesus,
This next sign was the second that Jesus accomplished,
cum venisset a Judæa in Galilæam.
after he had arrived in Galilee from Judea.
